outcome: Dissolved a vampire's corpse in a barrel of chaurus acid on Shanath's orders.
citation: s20 journal: "I now need to carefully place the vampire's body in to the barrel." (s20 obj: Drop the n'wah's body into the barrel)

outcome: Took position beside the Sadrith Kegran scientists and fought off the assault on the settlement.
citation: RUNTIME-VERIFY: s230 has an objective only -- "Prepare for battle. Take your position next to the scientists" (s240 obj: Stay alive)

outcome: Took Dwemer books and scrolls out of the library depository for Yen-Ylu, behind his master Shanath's back.
citation: s280 journal: "Yen-Ylu asked me to fetch any Dwemer books or scrolls from the library's depository. Apparently, he is at odds with Shanath Selthri."

outcome: Killed Shanath Selthri before he could summon the AHO.
citation: RUNTIME-VERIFY: s260 has an objective only -- "Kill Shanath Selthri before he summons the AHO"
branch_note: Branch: stood against Shanath. Mutually exclusive with the s261/s666 branch that joins him.

outcome: Sided with Shanath, let Sadrith Kegran be destroyed, and took the AHO for himself.
citation: s666 journal: "Sadrith Kegran is no more. I am in control of the AHO now." (reached via s261: "Rendezvous with Shanath Selthri at Deep Folk Crossing")
branch_note: Branch: joined Shanath. Mutually exclusive with the s260/s1000 branch that saves the settlement.

outcome: Launched the AHO with Yen-Ylu's leave and saved Sadrith Kegran.
citation: s1000 journal: "Yen-Ylu allowed me to launch AHO. ... Sadrith Kegran is saved."
branch_note: Branch: settlement saved. Mutually exclusive with the s666 destruction ending.

outcome: Handed the recovered ring back to Tadys Andavel so he could give it to his wife.
citation: s100 journal: "Now that Tadys has the ring, he can present it to Selveni."
branch_note: Branch: ring returned. Mutually exclusive with s101.

outcome: Kept for himself the ring Tadys had prepared as a gift for his wife.
citation: s101 journal: "I think I'd rather keep the ring for myself."
branch_note: Branch: ring kept. Mutually exclusive with s100.

outcome: Carried out the Morag Tong hit on the Orys family.
citation: s250 journal: "The job's done. I should speak to Evos Mils." (contract stated at s20: "The Morag Tong has ordered a hit on them. I am to kill them both -- or at least one of them.")
branch_note: Branch: contract fulfilled. Mutually exclusive with s100.

outcome: Spared the Orys family, let them leave Sadrith Kegran, and told Evos Mils they had run away.
citation: s100 journal: "The Orys family will soon depart from Sadrith Kegran. I should speak with Evos Mils and tell him they ran away."
branch_note: Branch: targets spared. Mutually exclusive with s250.

outcome: Drank the night away with Shaglak at the tavern until he could not remember it.
citation: s10 journal: "Shaglak offered me drinks, on him, at a local tavern of Sadrith Kegran called "Chitin and Flin"."

outcome: Tested Erver Milo's untried experimental time-magic scroll on himself.
citation: s10 journal: "Erver has given me an experimental scroll. I should put it to test."
branch_note: Single path; paired with the s40 row.

outcome: Saw Erver Milo's ancestral time-manipulation spell through to a scroll that worked.
citation: s40 journal: "I've managed to help Erver Milo." (s35: "The scroll worked as intended.")
branch_note: Single path; paired with the s10 row.

outcome: Repaired Maren Dwyn's broken amulet and mended his courtship with Aryni Sendu.
citation: s50 journal: "Maren plans on giving Aryni a gift. Their relationship will soon rebound." (s30: "I've successfully repaired the amulet!")

outcome: Carved ten pieces of bark off the living Tel And sprouts so they could be made into weapons.
citation: s15 journal: "Merano Rendo asked me to obtain ten pieces of Tel And bark from its sprouts."
branch_note: Single path; paired with the s30 row.

outcome: Learned the craft of Tel And bark weapons and took a bow made from it.
citation: s30 journal: "Merano Rendo gave me a bow made from Tel And bark and explained how I can use the giant mushroom's bark to craft my own items."
branch_note: Single path; paired with the s15 row.

outcome: Killed Slyboots, the creature living in the catacombs beneath the Andavel home.
citation: RUNTIME-VERIFY: s13 has an objective only -- "Kill Slyboots"; the choice is framed at s10: "I should try to feed it or kill it."
branch_note: Branch: creature killed. Mutually exclusive with feeding it.

outcome: Fed Slyboots rather than killing it.
citation: RUNTIME-VERIFY: s15 carries no journal text and no objective; the feed path of s10's "I should try to feed it or kill it" resolves through one of s15/s17/s19 and the exact stage is unconfirmed.
branch_note: Branch: creature spared. Mutually exclusive with s13; stage number unconfirmed.

outcome: Finished the dead Dwemer Kuovin Nrezalf's work and let him pass on without ever telling him he had died.
citation: s50 journal: "The mysterious ghost of the Dwemer disappeared. He never realized he had died more than four thousand years ago."
